title: Additivity of the Shapley value
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ and $g$ be real-valued functions on the subsets of an $n$-element set, and let $i$ be an element of that set. The Shapley value of $f+g$ at $i$ is the sum of the Shapley values of $f$ and $g$ at $i$.
hypotheses_covered: $f,g$ are real-valued functions on the subsets of an $n$-element set
$i$ is an element of the underlying $n$-element set
